technical_pending.reason: TECH_PENDING_NO_CAUSAL_DATA, never INCOMPATIBLE. OHLC sensitivity runs separate and labelled.

baseline.meaning: Economic R500 reference kept exact at configuration level; realized grid/cost effects reported; overshoot profile explicit. Baseline is included in matrix, not three extra independent experiments.

counts.note: One frozen instrument/corpus/horizon/prop/cost/event-policy profile. Additional independently justified scenarios must explicitly multiply count; no hidden parameter grids. Runtime inactive cycles/technical pending do not reduce expected manifest count.

policy_contract.notation: rho=R/T is risk:benefit, not reward:risk. R,T are positive net USD for complete aggregate cycle. Frozen at cycle admission; changes due to fit/progression occur before entry only. Cost model version is mandatory.

signal.formula: rawK_t=100*(close_t-min(low,20))/(max(high,20)-min(low,20)); slowK=SMA(rawK,3); D=SMA(slowK,3). On completed contiguous1m bars: Kprev<20 and Know>=20 LONG; Kprev>80 and Know<=80 SHORT. No K/D filter.
signal.flat_range: DESIGN_PROPOSAL: rawK=50 when rolling high=low; no division by zero.
signal.atr: TR_t=max(high-low,abs(high-prev_close),abs(low-prev_close)); first TR=high-low. ATR20 seeded SMA first20 TR; thereafter ATR=(19*prevATR+TR)/20.
signal.warmup: Require20 valid OHLC bars +2 for first slowK (bar22) +1 for previous/current slowK pair => earliest signal bar23. D first available bar24 and is informational, never a gating filter. ATR first available bar20. Suppress signals until K pair and ATR valid; D absence onbar23 does not suppress signal.
signal.reset: Preserve across NY daily boundaries with actual contiguous corpus; reset on contract/instrument roll, missing1m interval or invalid OHLC; rewarm without fabricated bars. Overnight bars may warm indicators but no execution outside NY. Session gaps must be declared trading-calendar scheduled closures or reset.
signal.causal: Signal timestamp is1m close; consume episode once globally. Entry only on a subsequent executable event after close plus configured latency. No same earlier OHLC price. No replay/reset when account changes. Account paused does not regain consumed signal.

risk.realized_gain: G=max(0, account net realized daily PnL); floated PnL excluded. RISK-FIX Rpref=Rbase,Tpref=Rbase/rho.
risk.gain_TP: DESIGN_PROPOSAL: latch earned_gain_credit=max(0,daily realized PnL) only after a cycle closes via TP; after nonTP closure clamp credit=min(previous_credit,max(0,current realized daily PnL)); daily reset credit0. Rpref=Rbase+credit; Tpref=Rbase/rho. Effective ratio may differ from rho.
risk.admission: Preferred amount never bypasses internal floor, official daily loss, account floor, maximum contracts, fees or reservations. If Rpreferred not admissible reduce both R/T proportionally only for FIT policies that permit adjustment; exact-fixed pauses NO_ADMISSIBLE_CYCLE. Never fail account just to expend remainder.

fit.common: remaining objective g is evaluation day target minus realized net daily PnL, or funded gross-withdrawal eligible progress gap converted by profile to required net cycle PnL. Requires phase-specific mapping; gross payout is not net profit/cash. Stop admission when objective reached. Cents arithmetic then physical grid.
fit.FIT-EXACT-FIXED: R/T same preferred values on every new cycle. Explicit DESIGN_PROPOSAL overshoot envelope permits one initial T beyond current objective: objective+Tpreferred; cancel further entries at first goal crossing or phase transition. It never relaxes account/prop limits; strict objective envelope profiles are incompatible rather than silently clipped.
fit.FIT-EQUAL: RISK-FIX only. n=max(1,ceil(g/Tpreferred)), T=g/n,R=rho*T. Recompute after every realized closure including loss/partial-cycle final settlement; R<=Rbase. Funded applies same finite objective partition.
fit.FIT-REMAINDER: scale=min(1,g/Tpreferred,admissible_R/Rpreferred); R=scale*Rpreferred,T=scale*Tpreferred. Pause if physical quantity cannot fit.
fit.FIT-BAND: DESIGN_PROPOSAL tolerance10USD. Stop when realized day/phase objective is within [goal-10,goal+10], but this cannot create prop approval/withdrawal eligibility below regulatory minimum. Before next cycle T=min(Tpreferred,g+10); scale=T/Tpreferred, cap proportional R for admissible headroom. No target below or above band manufactured by fills. Funded eligibility still requires PAY gross actual.
fit.physical_realization: Report requested/effective R,T,rho, residual, actual fills and budget utilization; no fraction contracts, perfect arithmetic claim, or fake exact daily close.

sequence.SEQ-HIGH-RESIDUAL: At day start use actual P=total evaluation net realized profit from completed days and M=max positive completed day profit (0 if none). DESIGN_PROPOSAL cents: lower=max(3000-P, floor_cents(M/0.30-P)+0.01,0.01); upper=0.30*P/0.70 from requirement x/(P+x)<0.30. If lower<=870 and lower<upper and all profile pass prerequisites can be met today, choose target lower; otherwise870. Once selected target remains frozen for day; intraday fit uses remaining actual realized PnL. At phase approval transition stop immediately, even if chosen target not reached. Handle final-day losses via g; next day recompute from state.
sequence.SEQ-HIGH-FULL: Daily870 even after losses; mandatory phase transition preempts goal. Four870 is arithmetic illustration only, not permission to trade after pass.
sequence.funded: SEQ axis affects evaluation only. No inherited870 or evaluation consistency ceiling in funded.
sequence.strictness: Use exact integer cents/rational comparison10*max_day<3*total at pass. Equality rejects. Profile minimum days/active conditions are separate pass gates, no first-day consistency failure.

economic_prices.aggregate: For signed direction s=+1 long/-1 short, quantity Q>0, weighted open average A, multiplier m, realized partial-cycle net L, already charged cost C and projected exit cost/slippage Cexit(Q,p), net cycle liquidation N(p)=L+s*Q*m*(p-A)-C-Cexit. L/C ownership ledger must avoid double cost subtraction; derive prices from authoritative ledger rather than reaccounting fills.
economic_prices.targets: Solve N(pSL)=-R and N(pTP)=T; BE solve N(pBE)=0. R/T are frozen net cycle envelopes. Partial fills update Q,A,L,cost estimates without resetting R/T.
economic_prices.sizing: Reference initial adverse price distance dref=2*ATR at known entry event. Choose largest integer Q whose conservative grid SL loss+all known roundtrip costs/slippage <=R and account-wide admission passes; actual instrument tick/value metadata required. If Q0 do not trade. After actual entry fill solve economic SL/TP subject to actual economics; ATR scale is secondary.
economic_prices.rounding: DESIGN_PROPOSAL: SL round toward entry (long ceil to tick, short floor) so planned loss never exceeds R; TP round away from entry (long ceil, short floor) then ensure objective envelope still permits it; if no feasible grid choose smaller Q or pause, never round through risk cap. BE round to nonnegative net side. Risk precedes ratio, which precedes exact ATR distance. Report deviations.
economic_prices.cost_bounds: Stop gaps/slippage may exceed plannedR; record actual breach, enforce floor/pause on first causal event; model cannot promise stop fill price. Unknown costs/slippage are pending inputs, not zero.

adds.trigger: Entry first accepted fill price E; fixed reference initial economic stop distance d0=abs(E-initial SL), not later moved stop and not ATR refreshed. Long trigger E-f*d0; short E+f*d0, f=.25/.50/.75. One add qinitial maximum, qinitial measured actual completed initial entry. No new add after BE activation.
adds.admissibility: At causal adverse crossing, simulate candidate real add fill costs/Q/A and re-solve BOTH economic SL,TP with same originalR/T. New SL must protect existing+new exposure and remain valid market side; quantity/account reservations/order state must be admissible. Reject ADD_INVALID_SL, GAP_PAST_TRIGGER, FLOOR_OR_HEADROOM, MAX_CONTRACTS, PROTECTION_UNAVAILABLE with evidence; no fill at crossed historical level.
adds.replace: Adapter/engine capability owns cancel/replace ordering. Pending old stops remain executable until ack, partial fills accounted once. No assumption atomic modification. During unsafe transition block add; cannot first increase exposure and hope protection follows. Add fills count against one aggregate cycle not new risk budget.

exits.EXIT-FIX: Original net cycle SL/TP only; B2 recalculates prices while preserving monetaryR/T.
exits.EXIT-BE200: When N(actual liquidation quote)>=200 on defined causal trigger event activate economicBE once; maintain originalT. If market cannot accept economicBE validly record inactive/rejected protection, never synthetic earlier stop.
exits.EXIT-BE200-TP500: BE event additionally requests monetaryT=500 once only if Tinitial<500 and applicable objective envelope allows500. This is sole explicit exception to originalT; R remains original and protectedBE then0planned. If Tinitial=500 equivalent; if Tinitial>500 extension inactive.
exits.timing: ONCLOSE samples liquidatable net value at completed1m close, amendment executable only after close+latency. INTRABAR samples ordered market events; barOHLC alone cannot assert crossing order.
exits.precedence: For each ordered event: externally confirmed fills/account failures first; forced session/floor/internal pause next; already executable SL/TP per causal execution; phase/goal transitions next; BE then adds then new signal admission. Account transition/flat shutdown cancels pending adds. Ties without causal evidence use separately declared conservative stop-first sensitivity policy and flag, never claimed tick path. Barrier that executes before BE cannot be undone.

session.calendar: America/New_York IANA trading calendar; prop accounting timezone/EOD separate; ownerAmerica/Santiago reporting only. DST aware. NYOPEN excluded research currently.
session.window: DESIGN_PROPOSAL start10:00 inclusive, new-cycle/admission cutoff15:50 exclusive; liquidation begins15:50, all exposure/executable orders resolved before15:55. Explicit holiday/early-close: min(local proposed cutoff, official instrument/profile liquidation deadline minus5minutes); exact forced-close deadline from frozen profile. No open if insufficient causal close/fill window.
session.end: Do not invent flat if cancel/close unacknowledged or market unavailable; mark forced_close_failed/technical censored with still executable state. Last-data bar is not fake liquidation. Prices from real causal execution.

rotation.ROT-ORDER: Sort eligible existing accounts by creation sequence then stable accountID; keep selected account through cycles until applicable target/internalpause/realfailure/block/session.
rotation.ROT-NEAREST: DESIGN_PROPOSAL lexicographic at legal turn boundary: known scheduled pending-credit eligibility/date first only if account tradable; funded remaining distance to first requestedPAY next; evaluation remaining financial pass gap next; stableID tie. Compare phase priority funded before eval. No guessed future returns/dates; nontradable pending account excluded.
rotation.ROT-BALANCED: DESIGN_PROPOSAL at day start choose eligible account with fewest accumulated selected trading days then oldest last_selected_day then stableID. Increment at first actual cycle admission per account/day. Remain on chosen account for legal turn; recompute after pause/fail/goal with same counts; no trade-by-trade rotation.
rotation.purchase: Existing eligible before demand purchase; no fixed inventory/cohort. Cash only actual net credited minus real debits; one purchase120 at a time respecting profile cups and future available trading window. Pause is not failure/reset. Feed/indicators shared, mutable financial/MM/account states isolated.

funded.PAY: Gross request targets2250/2300/2500/3000; profile decides eligible profit/reserve mapping, split, fees, latencies, cutoff/process/credit. First reference2250 inclusive split governed externally verified profile.

funded.PENDING: DESIGN_PROPOSAL pause until credited or rejection fully resolved; preserve obligation and actual reservation semantics; does not guarantee payout. Withdrawals not repeatedly infinite; profile limits/transitions/finalLiveSim enforced.
